title: Slowly and Softly
lines: Tim went to look for his red ball.
It was in the shed on a shelf.
A big dog naps by that shed all day.
Tim did not want to wake him up.
He went in fast to get the ball.
But his foot bumped a tin pan.
It fell loudly on the rocks by the step.
The dog slept on. Tim did not run.
This time Tim went slowly and softly.
He set each foot down neatly on the mat.
He got the ball and held it tightly.
Then the dog got up and looked at Tim.
It licked his hand kindly and sat down.
Tim gave him a soft pat and went in.

questions.ask: Why did Tim not want to make a sound?
questions.listenFor: A big dog naps by that shed all day. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What went wrong when Tim went in fast?
questions.listenFor: His foot bumped a tin pan and it fell loudly on the rocks.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim was scared of the dog at first? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Ask which words made them think so.
